spans.s:
ओघ ओघ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वह्), flood,
stream; a torrent, a rapid flow of water, an inunda-
tion; a heap or quantity, flock, multitude, abundance;
the whole; quick time in music; tradition, traditional
advice or instruction; [cf. Gr. ὄχλος?].
—ओघ-रथ,
अस्, m., N. of a son of Oghavat and brother of Ogha-
vatī.
—ओघ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a strong stream;
(आन्), m., N. of a prince, father-in-law or brother-in-
law of Sudarśana; (ती), f., N. of a daughter of Ogha-
vat; N. of the river Sarasvatī.
